Subject: AtlasOps term reshuffle & capacity runway — kickoff and QBR scheduling

Hi Sandra —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our call, I wanted to kick off a short renewal/expansion planning thread so we can lock timelines, stakeholders, and an initial QBR slot. High-level goals from Orbital that we captured:

- Move from current 12-month term to a 24-month commitment with stepped capacity increases across Q4–Q1.
- Add a 2x burst pool for seasonal batch runs (expected Nov–Dec).
- Formalize SLO commitments for inference latency at 95th pct (target: < 250ms) for the production model.

Proposed kickoff plan (two-week initial runway):
1) This week — mutual action plan (MAP) + legal/finance touchpoints; agree on amendment scope (term + burst).
2) Next week — internal ops readiness checklist (scheduling maintenance windows for migration), pricing term spreadsheet finalized.
3) QBR — schedule an in-person/remote QBR week of Aug 17 (two 45-min blocks: Exec & Ops).

Can you confirm: primary procurement contact (Ben?) and target exec(s) for the QBR? I’ve attached a draft MAP and a placeholder amendment doc for legal.

Attachments: AtlasOps_MAP_v1.pdf (mutual action plan), Amendment_Draft_v0.1.docx (legal draft)

Next steps for Redwood: I’ll loop in David from Solutions to scope the latency targets and Kimberly to validate capacity uplift windows.

High-level ask for Orbital by EOD Wed: confirm procurement email, two preferred QBR times (Aug 17–19), and any hard cutover blackout dates.

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Thanks for the quick reply and the QBR slots — Aug 18 (Exec at 09:00 PT) and Aug 19 (Ops at 10:00 PT) work for Redwood.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Stepped burst pools: David included a short runbook below (we'll attach a concise ops readout). In short: we size a reserved pool for steady usage and provision a temporary burst pool that bills at a short-term uplift rate; we include automatic rollback to reserved baseline after the window unless you opt to extend.
- Escape windows / term flexibility: We can draft an amendment with two 90-day review points (months 6 and 15) where either party can propose adjustments; financials are tiered by effective capacity brackets. Legal will draft optional escape language for finance review.

Action items I’ve captured:
- Rachel: finalize MAP and share link to collaborative doc (today).
- David: attach ops readout + sample burst costing (by Wed).
- Kimberly: populate maintenance blackout constraints into our deployment calendar.
- Ben / procurement: confirm procurement paperwork preference (SOW + amendment vs single amendment) and PO lead.

Attachments queued: AtlasOps_MAP_v1.pdf (updated link), QBR_invite.ics

Rachel
